property_summary: If getFirstWithdrawalBonus(recipient) reverts, it must be because the recipient had already claimed the bonus before the call; therefore a first-time call for any recipient either succeeds or the recipient cannot receive Ether, and after any successful call a second call reverts.

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: whether a call `getFirstWithdrawalBonus(args)` reverts or completes, and on which inputs
